age.mechanism: maturation and decline of enzyme and renal function

weight.mechanism: V and allometric scaling of CL

renal_function.mechanism: renal CL of parent and metabolites

albumin.mechanism: fraction unbound, hence CL and V of bound drugs

ddi.mechanism: a named interaction with a mechanism

adherence.mechanism: whether the dose history is real

targets.members: the pharmacological target, for PD not PK

GEO.what_it_is: transcriptomic series, indexed by ASSAY not phenotype

PRIDE.what_it_is: proteomic deposits, often beside DMPK papers

DIABLO.what_it_is: multi-block integration. NOT a biological source

pk_parameters.CL_metabolic: metabolic clearance, a COMPONENT of CL and not CL
pk_parameters.concentration: a measured concentration at a stated time

functional_endpoints.enzyme_activity: probe turnover by an enzyme, in vitro
functional_endpoints.clint_in_vitro: intrinsic clearance in microsomes or hepatocytes. A component of metabolic clearance measured outside a body, with no absorption, binding or blood flow
functional_endpoints.metabolite_ratio: a metabolic ratio used as a phenotype proxy
functional_endpoints.binding: plasma protein or tissue binding, fraction unbound

H5.minimum_comparator: the dosing rule already in use

H1.why: compatible: the legacy objective is one drug's instance of the new question

H2.why: compatible in spirit; the new H2 adds the prospective, before-acquisition task the legacy one never had

H3.why: legacy H3 is parsimony, a PROPERTY of a selection. The new H3 is a question about functional endpoints. No mapping

H4.why: legacy H4 is when omics become harmful. The new H4 is longitudinal. No mapping, and reusing the tag would claim longitudinal data that does not exist

H5.why: legacy H5 is analytical robustness. The new H5 is dose personalisation. No mapping

pride_pxd066482_imatinib_clearance.label: PRIDE PXD066482 - interindividual variability in imatinib metabolism in human liver microsomes and primary human hepatocytes, CYP2C8 and CYP3A phenotypes
pride_pxd066482_imatinib_clearance.provenance: PRIDE project description, retrieved 2026-11-12: individual-donor HLM and PHH incubated with imatinib for clearance and N-desmethyl-imatinib formation, with CYP2C8 and CYP3A activity, protein concentration AND genotype on the same donors
pride_pxd066482_imatinib_clearance.why_it_matters: the only inventoried source carrying genotype, protein, activity and a clearance on the same units. That is the H3 design, and the PGx comparator H3 needs is present
pride_pxd066482_imatinib_clearance.what_is_missing: the PRIDE deposit holds the proteomics; the clearance, activity and genotype tables are in the publication's supplement and are NOT yet verified as public. n per donor is not stated in the deposit metadata

pride_pxd057282_tucatinib_clearance.label: PRIDE PXD057282 - impact of variation in CYP3A and CYP2C8 on tucatinib metabolic clearance in human liver microsomes
pride_pxd057282_tucatinib_clearance.provenance: PRIDE project description, retrieved 2026-11-12: 21 donors, 11 male and 10 female, tucatinib depletion plus CYP2C8, CYP3A4 and CYP3A5 concentrations by QTAP and measured CYP activities
pride_pxd057282_tucatinib_clearance.why_it_matters: same design as PXD066482 with a different drug, so it is a replication candidate rather than a second discovery set
pride_pxd057282_tucatinib_clearance.what_is_missing: no genotype stated, so the PGx comparator H3 needs is absent. Commercial microsomes, so no clinical covariates beyond sex

pride_pxd060653_alcohol_dme_ensemble.label: PRIDE PXD060653 - effects of chronic alcohol intake on the ensemble of drug-metabolising enzymes
pride_pxd060653_alcohol_dme_ensemble.why_it_matters: a PERTURBATION of the enzyme proteome, which is the shape H4 needs even though this design is between groups rather than within individuals
pride_pxd060653_alcohol_dme_ensemble.what_is_missing: no paired PK, no repeated occasions, pairing not asserted. Cannot carry H4 as it stands

pride_pxd014131_liver_compartments.label: PRIDE PXD014131 - human liver homogenate, microsomes, low-speed pellet and hepatocytes
pride_pxd014131_liver_compartments.why_it_matters: four COMPARTMENTS of the same organ, which is the 'which compartment to measure' axis of the brief and the only inventoried source addressing it
pride_pxd014131_liver_compartments.what_is_missing: no functional endpoint and no PK; pairing unstated

what_this_is_not.a_catalogue_is_not_a_result: listing what could be measured says nothing about whether it carries information. Every entry here is a candidate until a pre-registered contrast says otherwise.
what_this_is_not.an_activity_is_not_a_pk_parameter: clint_in_vitro has clearance units and is measured with no absorption, no binding and no blood flow. It informs metabolic clearance, which is itself a component of CL.
what_this_is_not.pairing_is_never_inferred: two layers reported in different publications are not paired, however similar their cohorts. The pairing field must be asserted from the source, and `unknown` blocks joint analysis.
what_this_is_not.the_legacy_labels_are_a_different_vocabu: the registry's H4 is 'when omics become harmful' and its H5 is analytical robustness. Reusing those tags for the longitudinal and dosing hypotheses would claim data that does not exist.
what_this_is_not.a_method_is_not_a_source: DIABLO integrates blocks; it supplies no biology. The kind field exists so a matrix cannot put a statistical choice where a biological fact belongs.
